label: Business Card
description: The m0saic business card, print-ready: US 3.5 x 2 in at 300 DPI on MOO's bleed box (1098 x 648 px; Vistaprint / FedEx presets too), the brand field + M lockup and your contact on the front, a live-rendered shipped template with a QR to Mosaic Web on the back. One render, two PNGs (front + back). Every line on the front is editable on the canvas.

name.label: Name
name.description: Your name — the bold line on the front. Double-click it to add any contact line that is empty.

role.label: Role
role.description: Role / company line under the name. Empty removes it.

email.label: Email
email.description: Email address, set in the mono face. Empty removes it.

site.label: Site
site.description: Website, set in the mono face. Empty removes it.

handle.label: Handle
handle.description: Social handle, printed beside the site. Empty removes it.

back.label: Back
back.description: Which shipped template the back of the card shows (rendered live, with a QR that opens it on Mosaic Web).

bleed.label: Bleed
bleed.description: Printer bleed per side: "moo" (MOO — 3.66 x 2.16 in, 1098 x 648 px at 300 DPI, exact), "none" (trim only, 3.5 x 2 in), "sixteenth" (Vistaprint), "eighth" (FedEx Office / Staples).

dpi.label: DPI
dpi.description: Print resolution in dots per inch — every dimension scales with it. 300 is press standard.

fieldOpacity.label: Field opacity
fieldOpacity.description: Tint of the field tiles over the navy. The app uses 0.16; print stock needs more contrast.

accent.label: Accent
accent.description: Accent colour — the M and the wordmark's zero.

guides.label: Proof guides
guides.description: Draw the trim (orange) and safe-area (green) outlines for proofing. Off for the press file.

debugLayout.label: Debug layout
debugLayout.description: Dev-only: overlay the layout contract (every mark keeps its aspect, the back's template keeps its own, every glyph stays inside the safe area).
